summary: One-line fix converts Path instances to str before the default-fixture-dir membership check, correctly resolving the undetected-duplicate bug when FIXTURE_DIRS holds Path objects. Matches Django's actual accepted fix for the ticket; minimal and correct.

issues.description: List comprehension [str(d) for d in fixture_dirs] rebuilt on every loop iteration over app_configs; could be computed once before the loop. Negligible impact, not blocking.
